title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 179 ]

blocks.text: The early volunteers worked alone and did hard and unpleasant tasks. They devoted themselves to hours of unpaid work for the poor and helpless, never minding that few appreciated what they were doing for society. Up until about two decades ago, they had seldom received funds from the government or private organizations. This was so mainly because society paid little attention to their activities or achievements. Then, in the last ten to 15 years, changes in society brought about a transformation of volunteerism. In the first place, more people and organizations wanted to be involved in helping solve social problems out of their love for humanity. Volunteers grew in number, organized themselves, and became professional. Secondly, society as a whole began to place a great value on the experience or training that comes from volunteer work. Many employers, for instance, are now looking for would-be workers with training. So those seeking a job -- the young and the unskilled -- realize that the best way to get hired is to acquire some experience from volunteer work. The result has been a considerable increase in the number of volunteers in recent years.

readingSentences.korean: 초기의 자원 봉사자들은 혼자서 힘들고 불쾌한 작업을 해냈다.

readingSentences.english: They devoted themselves to hours of unpaid work for the poor and helpless, never minding that few appreciated what they were doing for society.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은, 사회를 위해 그들이 행하는 것에 가치를 인정해주는 사람들이 거의 없다는 것을 전혀 꺼리지 않고, 가난한 자와 절망적인 사람들을 위해 무보수의 여러 시간 일하는데 헌신하였다.

readingSentences.english: Up until about two decades ago, they had seldom received funds from the government or private organizations.
readingSentences.korean: 약 20년전까지만도 정부와 사설 단체로부터 거의 자금을 지원받지 못했다.

readingSentences.english: This was so mainly because society paid little attention to their activities or achievements.
readingSentences.korean: 이는 주로 사회가 그들의 활동이나 업적에 관심을 두지 않았기 때문이었다.

readingSentences.english: Then, in the last ten to 15 years, changes in society brought about a transformation of volunteerism.
readingSentences.korean: 그런데 지난 10년에서 15년에 걸쳐, 사회의 변화가 자원봉사에도 변화를 가져왔다.

readingSentences.english: In the first place, more people and organizations wanted to be involved in helping solve social problems out of their love for humanity.
readingSentences.korean: 우선 보다 많은 사람과 단체가 인류애에 입각해 사회문제 해결에 도움이 되는 일에 참여하기를 원했다.

readingSentences.english: Volunteers grew in number, organized themselves, and became professional.
readingSentences.korean: 자원봉사자의 수가 증가하였고, 스스로를 조직화했으며 전문화되었다.

readingSentences.english: Secondly, society as a whole began to place a great value on the experience or training that comes from volunteer work.
readingSentences.korean: 둘째로 사회전체가 자원봉사활동에서 오는 경험과 훈련에 큰 가치를 두기 시작하였다.

readingSentences.english: Many employers, for instance, are now looking for would-be workers with training.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어, 많은 고용주들이 그런 훈련 경험을 가진 가능성 있는 직원을 찾고 있다.

readingSentences.english: So those seeking a job -- the young and the unskilled -- realize that the best way to get hired is to acquire some experience from volunteer work. The result has been a considerable increase in the number of volunteers in recent years.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 직업을 구하는 사람들 - 젊은이와 미숙련자 - 는, 고용되기 위한 최선의 방법이 자원봉사활동으로 다소의 경험을 얻는 것이라는 걸 깨닫고 있다. 그래서, 최근에 자원 봉사자의 수가 상당히 증가하였다.
